task.pr_title: 🐛 Fix support for strings in OpenAPI status codes: `default`, `1XX`, `2XX`, `3XX`, `4XX`, `5XX`

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
This wont fix the OpenAPI status code range definitions, right?

See: https://swagger.io/docs/specification/describing-responses/#status-codes

evidence.attached_diff_hunk:
@@ -19,7 +19,7 @@
 
 
 def is_body_allowed_for_status_code(status_code: Union[int, str, None]) -> bool:
-    if status_code is None:
+    if status_code is None or status_code == "default":
evidence.thread_resolution:
JarroVGIT: That is correct, that is currently not supported. Was that working prior to 0.79? The fix would be easy though:

`if status_code is None or status_code == "default" or status_code in ["1XX", "2XX", "3XX", "4XX", "5XX"]:`
MarkusSintonen: > Was that working prior to 0.79?

Yes that was working previously. So eg defining:
```
FastAPI(..., responses={"5XX": {"model": ServerErrorResponse, "description": "Unknown Server Error"}})
```
Yields spec like in https://swagger.io/docs/specification/describing-responses/#status-codes for all of the routes.

Probably these unit tests should be extended to cover the regression: https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/blob/master/tests/test_additional_responses_router.py
JarroVGIT: i'd agree, I'll update the PR when i have time (propably tomorrow). Didn't know about the ranges, did you open an issue about those? I'll reference them in this PR for closure then.
